title: Ten Years of the Guggenheim’s Latin American Circle
summary: The LAC has supported the acquisition of works by over one hundred artists, more than doubling the presence of artists from Latin America in the collection.

title: Three Degrees in the Forecast: The 1956 Artists’ Response to Frank Lloyd Wright’s Ramp
summary: The Guggenheim's Spring 2026 Library and Archives intern explores initial responses to Frank Lloyd Wright's radical curved ramp inside the iconic museum.
